integrity: Proof uses exact grounded-Laplacian inversion, strict chord factorization, and endpoint comparison. An independent finite exact-rational checker corroborates the proof; enumeration alone is not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact unweighted simple K_{m,m+1}, m>=2, for exactly 1<=k<=2m noise-free leaders and unnormalized grounded-inverse trace only. Does not classify arbitrary K_{m,n}, other costs, weighted links, or noisy leaders. No historical-priority guarantee or independent mathematical validation.
title: A square-root leader-budget switch on nearly balanced complete bipartite networks
